recipes.title: Creamy Stovetop Brown Rice, Blueberry & Banana Cinnamon Porridge
recipes.summary: Comforting warm breakfast porridge simmering cooked brown rice with mashed banana, cinnamon, fresh ginger, blueberries, sliced almonds, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Combine cooked brown rice, oat milk, mashed banana, cinnamon, and grated ginger in a small saucepan.
Simmer gently over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until grains turn plush and creamy.
Fold in half the blueberries until warmed, ladle into bowls, and top with remaining blueberries, banana slices, sliced almonds, and flaxseed oil.
tips: Simmering pre-cooked brown rice in oat milk breaks down its natural starch into a soothing, easy-to-swallow morning porridge.
Cook an extra pot of brown rice at dinner so weekday breakfasts take only 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Restorative Velvet Ginger, Sesame Oil & Shredded Chicken Brown Rice Congee
recipes.summary: Silky Asian-style savory rice porridge simmering cooked brown rice in broth until spoon-soft with freshly grated ginger, carrot, celery, tender chicken, cilantro, and sesame oil.
steps: Bring cooked brown rice, broth, grated ginger, grated carrot, and minced celery to a gentle boil, then simmer uncovered over medium-low heat 15 minutes, stirring occasionally until thick and velvety.
Stir in finely shredded chicken and black pepper and warm 3 minutes more until piping hot and tender.
Ladle into cozy bowls and finish with toasted sesame oil and chopped fresh cilantro.
tips: Starting congee with already-cooked brown rice achieves cloud-soft texture in 18 minutes instead of over an hour.
Warm, hydrating, and wonderfully gentle to chew and swallow on slow mornings.

recipes.title: Warm Espresso, Dark Chocolate & Raspberry Brown Rice Breakfast Pudding
recipes.summary: Café-inspired morning rice pudding uniting warm brown rice, brewed coffee, melted dark chocolate, sweet Medjool dates, mashed banana, cinnamon, and juicy raspberries.
steps: Simmer cooked brown rice, almond milk, brewed coffee, mashed banana, minced dates, and cinnamon over low heat 8 to 10 minutes until rich and creamy.
Remove from heat and stir in two-thirds of the finely chopped dark chocolate until melted into glossy mocha ribbons.
Spoon into warm bowls and crown with fresh raspberries and remaining dark chocolate.
tips: Mashing half a ripe banana straight into the pot lends lush natural sweetness and pudding smoothness.
Delicious served warm or chilled overnight like a café parfait.

recipes.title: Silky Button Mushroom, Thyme & Olive Oil Savory Brown Rice Congee
recipes.summary: Earthy savory morning porridge simmering cooked brown rice into soft congee crowned with olive-oil sautéed button mushrooms, rosemary, thyme, celery leaves, and baby arugula.
steps: Simmer cooked brown rice with vegetable broth and half the thyme over medium-low heat 14 to 16 minutes, stirring occasionally until soft and creamy.
Meanwhile sauté sliced button mushrooms, minced rosemary, remaining thyme, and black pepper in olive oil for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and tender.
Wilt chopped arugula gently into the hot congee, ladle into bowls, and top with warm mushrooms and fresh celery leaves.
tips: Give the congee 10 quick pulses with an immersion blender if you prefer an even silkier velvet finish.
Savory grain breakfasts deliver gentle warmth without morning sugar spikes.

recipes.title: Warm Caramelized Apple, Blackberry & Clove Brown Rice Morning Bowl
recipes.summary: Autumn-spiced brown rice breakfast bowl simmering tender diced sweet apple with cinnamon, clove, ginger, blackberries, oat milk, and fragrant roasted walnut oil.
steps: Simmer finely diced apple, cooked brown rice, oat milk, cinnamon, grated ginger, and ground cloves over medium-low heat 8 to 10 minutes until apples turn soft and porridge thickens.
Fold fresh blackberries gently into the warm pot for 1 minute so they turn juicy.
Ladle into warm bowls and drizzle with aromatic roasted walnut oil.
tips: Drizzling roasted walnut oil off the heat protects its delicate aroma and omega-3 fatty acids.
Peeling and dicing the apple finely ensures soft comfort in every spoonful.

recipes.title: Honeyed Apricot, Orange Zest & Toasted Almond Sweet Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Mediterranean morning rice bowl gently warming cooked brown rice with jammy diced apricots, sweet Medjool dates, bright orange zest, cinnamon, almond milk, and sliced almonds.
steps: Simmer cooked brown rice, almond milk, diced apricots, chopped dates, orange juice, and cinnamon over low heat 9 to 10 minutes until velvety.
Stir in sweet almond oil and fresh orange zest off the heat.
Spoon into warm bowls and garnish with thin toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Sliced almonds stay delicate and easy to bite compared to whole nuts.
Naturally sweetened with dried fruit and fragrant citrus—zero refined sugar required.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric Chickpea, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Morning Brown Rice Skillet
recipes.summary: Savory one-pan breakfast folding warm cooked brown rice with lightly mashed golden turmeric-cumin chickpeas, sweet red bell pepper, olive oil, and fresh cilantro.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet and sauté finely diced red bell pepper for 3 minutes until soft.
Add lightly mashed chickpeas, turmeric, cumin, black pepper, and 3 tablespoons water; stir 2 minutes until fragrant and golden.
Fold in cooked brown rice and warm 3 to 4 minutes until steaming and moist, finishing with fresh cilantro.
tips: Adding a splash of water or broth to the skillet keeps brown rice steamy and plush rather than dry.
Pairing turmeric with black pepper and olive oil enriches both flavor and synergy.

recipes.title: Japanese-Inspired Flaked Salmon, Shiso & Sesame Oil Morning Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Traditional nourishing Japanese breakfast bowl pairing warm steamed brown rice with flaky tender salmon, shaved carrot, crisp cucumber, grated ginger, toasted sesame oil, and shiso.

ingredient_details.item: cooked flaky baked or poached salmon
fresh green or red shiso leaves

steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, 1 tablespoon low-sodium tamari, and 1 teaspoon rice vinegar in a small cup.
Divide steaming warm brown rice into two bowls and drizzle half the ginger-sesame dressing across the grains.
Arrange flaky tender salmon, grated carrot, paper-thin cucumber, and fresh shiso ribbons on top, finishing with remaining dressing.
tips: Flake extra salmon from the previous night's dinner so this omega-3 breakfast assembles in 6 minutes.
Pouring a splash of warm dashi or broth over the bowl turns it into soothing ochazuke-style rice soup.

recipes.title: Chilled Chamomile-Infused Sweet Cherry, Cashew & Brown Rice Morning Cup
recipes.summary: Make-ahead chilled breakfast pudding soaking cooked brown rice overnight in whipped chamomile-lavender cashew cream layered with sweet cherries and cinnamon.
steps: Blend chilled chamomile tea, drained cashews, pitted dates, cinnamon, and a light pinch of culinary lavender until silky smooth.
Stir two-thirds of the floral cashew milk into cooled brown rice, cover, and chill overnight until creamy.
Top morning jars with halved sweet cherries and the remaining velvet cream swirl.
tips: Chilled brown rice softens wonderfully overnight in homemade cashew-chamomile milk.
Grab-and-go jars make early mornings completely effortless.

recipes.title: Cozy Butternut Squash, Cranberry & Spiced Black-Tea Brown Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Aromatic harvest morning bowl simmering cooked brown rice and mashed butternut squash with chai-steeped black tea, oat milk, dates, cinnamon, ginger, clove, and cranberries.
steps: Combine cooked brown rice, mashed butternut squash, hot brewed black tea, oat milk, chopped cranberries, minced dates, cinnamon, ginger, and clove in a small saucepan.
Simmer gently over low heat 9 to 10 minutes until cranberries plump completely soft and porridge turns lush.
Divide into warm bowls and enjoy steaming.
tips: Steeping your favorite black tea right into breakfast porridge infuses gentle chai aroma without any extra cookware.
Swap decaf black tea whenever you prefer caffeine-free warmth.

recipes.title: Warm Mediterranean Chickpea, Artichoke & Basil Olive Oil Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Sunlit Mediterranean grain bowl pairing warm brown rice with tender chickpeas, quartered artichoke hearts, cucumber, sweet bell pepper, fresh basil, tangy sumac, and olive oil.
steps: Warm chickpeas and chopped artichoke hearts briefly in 1 tablespoon olive oil with half the sumac for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Toss warm cooked brown rice with remaining olive oil, 1.5 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, and remaining sumac.
Divide rice into bowls and pile with warm chickpeas, artichokes, cool diced cucumber, bell pepper, and fresh basil.
tips: Serving the rice and chickpeas gently warm keeps every grain soft while fresh cucumber adds crisp contrast.
Packs cleanly into lunch containers for work or errands.

recipes.title: Silky Rice-Thickened Carrot, Sweet Apple & Coriander Ginger Bisque
recipes.summary: Naturally creamy dairy-free soup using cooked brown rice blended right into simmered sweet carrots, apple, fresh ginger, coriander seed, turmeric, olive oil, and cilantro.
steps: Sauté sliced carrots, diced apple, grated ginger, coriander, and turmeric in olive oil for 3 minutes until aromatic.
Add cooked brown rice and vegetable broth; cover and simmer 15 minutes until carrots are completely fork-soft.
Purée smoothly with an immersion blender until cloud-velvety and ladle into bowls topped with fresh cilantro.
tips: Blending cooked brown rice straight into vegetable soup creates classic French potage creaminess completely dairy-free and nut-free.
Gentle to sip from a warm mug whenever you want soothing comfort.

recipes.title: Jewel Roasted Beetroot, Orange & Walnut Oil Arugula Brown Rice Salad
recipes.summary: Colorful no-cook grain salad pairing tender brown rice with ruby roasted beetroot, juicy orange segments, baby arugula, celery, cumin, sumac, and roasted walnut oil.
steps: Whisk roasted walnut oil, fresh orange juice, ground cumin, sumac, and a pinch of salt in the bottom of a large bowl.
Toss cooled cooked brown rice, thinly sliced celery, and diced beetroot gently into the citrus dressing.
Fold in baby arugula and juicy orange segments right before serving.
tips: Pre-steamed beets and microwaveable brown rice pouches turn this vibrant bowl into a 10-minute zero-stove lunch.
Roasted walnut oil brings deep nutty richness with omega-3 benefits.

recipes.title: Flaky Poached Salmon, Asparagus & Dill-Seed Olive Oil Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Bright Nordic-inspired lunch bowl layering warm brown rice with gentle poached salmon, tender asparagus, crisp cucumber, arugula, crushed dill seed, and lemon olive oil.
steps: Poach salmon fillets gently in a covered skillet with 1/2 cup water, black pepper, and a pinch of salt for 6 minutes, adding asparagus for the final 3 minutes.
Whisk olive oil, 1.5 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, and crushed dill seeds together and toss half through the warm brown rice.
Top bowls of herbed brown rice with arugula, diced cucumber, tender asparagus, softly flaked salmon, and remaining lemon-dill oil.
tips: Steam-poaching keeps salmon remarkably juicy and easy to flake into tender bites.
Dill seeds stay fragrant in the pantry all year round.

recipes.title: Fragrant Ginger-Sesame Chicken, Sweet Basil & Cashew Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Zesty skillet bowl tossing finely minced chicken, sweet bell pepper, grated carrot, ginger, toasted sesame oil, fresh basil, cilantro, and chopped cashews over warm brown rice.

ingredient_details.item: ground chicken breast or finely diced chicken

steps: Cook ground chicken in half the sesame oil with grated ginger for 5 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Add finely diced red bell pepper, grated carrot, 1 tablespoon low-sodium tamari, and 1 tablespoon lime juice; stir-fry 3 minutes until bright and soft.
Spoon over warm brown rice and shower with remaining sesame oil, fresh sweet basil, cilantro, and finely chopped cashews.
tips: Ground chicken eliminates slicing and stays soft and scoopable over warm rice.
Grating the carrot blends sweetness evenly throughout every bite.

recipes.title: Savory One-Skillet Button Mushroom, Sage & Celery Leaf Brown Rice Pilaf
recipes.summary: Aromatic stovetop pilaf warming cooked brown rice with golden sautéed button mushrooms, grated carrot, fresh sage, thyme, celery leaves, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Sauté sliced button mushrooms, grated carrot, chopped sage, thyme, and black pepper in olive oil for 6 minutes until mushrooms turn golden and fragrant.
Stir in cooked brown rice and vegetable broth, cover, and steam gently 5 minutes until moisture absorbs and grains turn plush.
Fluff with a fork and fold in fresh chopped celery leaves right before serving.
tips: Adding 1/2 cup warm broth revives leftover refrigerated brown rice into freshly steamed softness.
Celery leaves bring bright herbaceous savoriness with zero extra cost.

recipes.title: Chilled Tender Chicken, Red Grape & Tarragon Almond-Oil Brown Rice Salad
recipes.summary: Classic picnic-ready grain salad combining shredded chicken, halved sweet red grapes, finely diced celery, sliced almonds, fresh tarragon, baby arugula, olive oil, and brown rice.
steps: Whisk olive oil, 1.5 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or lemon juice, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, chopped tarragon, and black pepper in a bowl.
Fold cooled cooked brown rice, shredded chicken, halved red grapes, and finely diced celery gently into the dressing.
Serve over fresh baby arugula crowned with delicate toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Juicy halved red grapes add cooling moisture so the salad never feels dry.
Keeps happily chilled for 2 days—add arugula right before eating.

recipes.title: Warm Roasted Butternut Squash, Cumin Chickpea & Cilantro Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Cozy sheet-pan grain bowl tossing tender spiced butternut squash, chickpeas, and sweet bell pepper in turmeric, cumin, and olive oil over warm brown rice with fresh cilantro.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). Toss cubed butternut squash, chickpeas, bell pepper, olive oil, cumin, turmeric, and salt on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes until squash turns caramel-soft and chickpeas are lightly golden.
Spoon warm roasted vegetables over steaming brown rice, squeeze fresh lime over top, and scatter chopped cilantro.
tips: Pre-cut cubed butternut squash lets you assemble this colorful tray in 5 minutes flat.
Drizzle an extra teaspoon of olive oil or tahini if you love extra creamy sauce.

recipes.title: Steamed Broccoli, Hydrated Chia & Lemon-Thyme Cashew Crema Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Nourishing green-and-gold bowl pairing warm brown rice, tender steamed broccoli, and sweet carrots with velvety lemon-thyme cashew cream infused with pre-hydrated chia seeds.

ingredient_details.note: pre-soaked 10 minutes in 3 tbsp warm water

equipment: Steamer basket or saucepan with lid
steps: Steam broccoli florets and thin carrot coins for 5 to 6 minutes until bright and fork-tender.
Blend drained soaked cashews, fully pre-soaked chia gel, olive oil, 1/4 cup warm water, 1.5 tablespoons lemon juice, thyme, black pepper, and salt into silky herb cream.
Spoon warm brown rice and tender steamed vegetables into bowls and ribbon generously with lemon-thyme cashew-chia crema.
tips: Pre-soaking both cashews and chia seeds creates an ultra-silky sauce that coats grains softly for easy swallowing.
Steaming rather than hard roasting keeps broccoli tender and bright green.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Shiso, Ginger & Toasted Sesame Brown Rice Bento Bowl
recipes.summary: Cooling bento-style bowl uniting room-temperature brown rice, creamy avocado, diced cucumber, grated carrot, celery, sweet bell pepper, fresh shiso, and ginger-sesame dressing.
steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, 1.5 tablespoons rice vinegar, and 1 tablespoon low-sodium tamari in a small cup.
Divide brown rice into two bowls and arrange diced cucumber, grated carrot, bell pepper, sliced celery, and ripe avocado neatly on top.
Drizzle with ginger-sesame dressing and finish with fragrant fresh shiso ribbons.
tips: Creamy ripe avocado ties crisp garden vegetables and tender brown rice together smoothly.
Great make-ahead bento—add avocado right before eating so it stays bright green.

recipes.title: One-Pan Golden Saffron, Fennel Seed & Steamed Clam Brown Rice Paella
recipes.summary: Shortcut coastal paella infusing cooked brown rice with steeped golden saffron, crushed fennel seed, bell pepper, celery, olive oil, and briny steamed clams topped with basil and orange zest.
steps: Warm olive oil in a wide skillet and sauté diced red bell pepper, celery, and crushed fennel seeds for 4 minutes until tender.
Stir in cooked brown rice, vegetable broth, and steeped saffron; bring to a gentle simmer.
Nestle scrubbed clams into the golden rice, cover tightly, and steam 6 to 8 minutes until shells open (discard unopened shells); garnish with fresh basil and orange zest.
tips: Using pre-cooked brown rice gives rich saffron-clam paella in under 20 minutes with guaranteed tender grains.
Serve straight from the wide skillet for relaxed family-style scooping.

recipes.title: Fragrant South Indian Curry Leaf, Turmeric & Cashew Chickpea Brown Rice Pilaf
recipes.summary: One-pot spiced pilaf folding cooked brown rice and tender chickpeas with fresh curry leaves, golden turmeric, coriander, ginger, sweet carrots, toasted cashews, and sesame oil.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a skillet and bloom fresh curry leaves, grated ginger, turmeric, and ground coriander for 45 seconds until deeply fragrant.
Add finely diced carrot, chickpeas, and light coconut milk with 1/4 cup water; cover and simmer 8 minutes until carrots turn soft.
Fold in cooked brown rice and chopped cashews, cover 4 minutes to steam gently together, and serve warm.
tips: Light coconut milk keeps the spiced brown rice velvety and moist without heavy richness.
Leftovers reheat wonderfully with a tiny splash of water.

recipes.title: Cozy Bahia-Style Annatto, Bell Pepper & Cilantro One-Pot Chicken Brown Rice
recipes.summary: Vibrant Brazilian-inspired one-pot supper simmering tender chicken bites, sweet bell pepper, ginger, cumin, and sunset-red annatto in coconut broth folded with brown rice and cilantro.
equipment: Deep skillet or Dutch oven with lid
steps: Heat olive oil in a deep skillet, stir in annatto, cumin, and grated ginger for 30 seconds, then soften diced bell peppers for 3 minutes.
Add small chicken cubes, light coconut milk, and 1/3 cup water; cover and simmer gently 13 minutes until chicken is completely fork-tender.
Stir in cooked brown rice, warm covered 3 minutes to soak up the golden-orange broth, and top with fresh lime and cilantro.
tips: Ground annatto lends gorgeous sunset color and warm peppery-nutty aroma with zero spicy burn.
Cutting chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces guarantees quick, tender cooking.

recipes.title: Tender Ginger-Sesame Beef, Broccoli & Carrot One-Pan Brown Rice Skillet
recipes.summary: Aromatic skillet dinner pairing thinly sliced lean beef, crisp-tender broccoli, carrot ribbons, bell pepper, ginger, subtle Sichuan pepper, and toasted sesame oil folded with brown rice.

ingredient_details.note: very thinly sliced across the grain

steps: Sear thinly sliced beef in half the sesame oil with black pepper and crushed Sichuan pepper for 2 to 3 minutes; transfer briefly to a plate.
Add broccoli, carrot coins, bell pepper, grated ginger, and 1/4 cup water to the skillet; cover and steam 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef and stir in cooked brown rice, remaining sesame oil, and 1.5 tablespoons low-sodium tamari; toss 2 minutes until steaming and glossy.
tips: Folding warm brown rice directly into the skillet lets every grain catch the ginger-sesame pan glaze.
Ask the meat counter to slice sirloin paper-thin for effortless prep.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Rosemary-Thyme Baked Salmon over Lemon Balm & Asparagus Brown Rice
recipes.summary: Tender oven-baked rosemary-thyme salmon and roasted asparagus served over warm olive-oil brown rice perfumed with fresh garden lemon balm and cracked black pepper.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). Arrange salmon fillets and asparagus on parchment, drizzle with half the olive oil, and season with rosemary, thyme, black pepper, and salt.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes softly with a fork and asparagus turns bright tender.
Toss warm brown rice with remaining olive oil, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and finely chopped lemon balm; divide into bowls and crown with baked salmon and asparagus.
tips: Fresh lemon balm releases gentle citrus-mint fragrance the instant it touches warm brown rice.
Parchment makes sheet-pan cleanup completely effortless.

recipes.title: Creamy Skillet Brussels Sprouts, Button Mushroom & Sage Brown Rice Risotto
recipes.summary: Velvety weeknight risotto uniting cooked brown rice, caramelized shredded Brussels sprouts, sautéed button mushrooms, sage, rosemary, olive oil, and smooth cashew cream.
steps: Blend drained soaked cashews with 1/2 cup warm water and a pinch of salt until velvet-smooth.
Sauté shredded Brussels sprouts, sliced mushrooms, sage, rosemary, and black pepper in olive oil with 2 tablespoons water for 7 minutes until tender and caramelized.
Stir in cooked brown rice and warm broth, simmer 5 minutes until saucy, then fold in silky cashew cream off the heat and serve hot.
tips: Shredded Brussels sprouts soften quickly and weave seamlessly through creamy brown rice risotto.
Zero constant standing required thanks to pre-cooked brown rice.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Moroccan Apricot, Cinnamon & Almond Beef Brown Rice Pilaf
recipes.summary: Fragrant spiced skillet pilaf braising small lean beef cubes with sweet carrots, dried apricots, cinnamon, cumin, ginger, cilantro, and sliced almonds folded with brown rice.
equipment: Heavy saucepan or Dutch oven with lid
steps: Brown small beef cubes gently in olive oil with cinnamon, cumin, and grated ginger for 3 minutes.
Add finely diced carrots, chopped apricots, and 1.25 cups low-sodium broth; cover and braise gently 20 minutes until beef and carrots are melt-in-the-mouth tender.
Fold cooked brown rice into the aromatic pot for 4 minutes until heated through and moist, then top with sliced almonds and chopped cilantro.
tips: Petite beef cubes stay juicy and easy to chew after gentle braising.
Warm Moroccan spices pair wonderfully with nutty whole-grain brown rice.

recipes.title: Hearty Tuscan Bay Leaf, Artichoke & Chickpea Brown Rice Minestrone
recipes.summary: Soothing Italian broth soup brimming with cooked brown rice, tender chickpeas, artichoke hearts, diced carrot, celery, crushed tomato, bay leaf, rosemary, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Sauté diced carrot, celery, minced rosemary, and black pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, 2.5 cups low-sodium vegetable broth, chickpeas, artichoke hearts, and the bay leaf; simmer gently 14 minutes until vegetables are completely soft.
Discard bay leaf, fold in cooked brown rice for 2 minutes to warm through, and finish bowls with a delicate ribbon of olive oil.
tips: Adding already-cooked brown rice right at the end prevents it from turning mushy or drinking up all the broth.
Hydrating, fiber-rich, and effortless to freeze in individual jars.

recipes.title: Cozy One-Dish Roasted Chicken, Cranberry, Apple & Butternut Brown Rice Bake
recipes.summary: Comforting autumn casserole baking bite-sized chicken, tender butternut squash, diced apple, jewel cranberries, rosemary, thyme, olive oil, and warm broth right over brown rice.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Stir cooked brown rice, bite-sized chicken pieces, small squash cubes, diced apple, cranberries, rosemary, thyme, olive oil, black pepper, and 3/4 cup low-sodium broth together in a baking dish.
Cover snugly with foil or a lid and bake 22 to 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and squash is fork-tender.
Uncover, fluff lightly with a fork, and serve warm.
tips: Covered baking steams the chicken, fruit, and brown rice together so every forkful stays moist and tender.
One single dish goes straight from counter to oven to table.

recipes.title: Silky Cashew-Cream Broccoli, Artichoke & Sweet Basil Brown Rice Skillet Bake
recipes.summary: Dairy-free comfort-food classic swirling cooked brown rice, steamed broccoli, and chopped artichoke hearts in velvet thyme-basil cashew cream warmed until bubbling.
steps: Blend drained soaked cashews with 3/4 cup warm water, olive oil, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast, thyme, black pepper, and salt until velvety.
Combine cooked brown rice, lightly steamed broccoli florets, chopped artichoke hearts, and creamy cashew sauce in a skillet.
Warm gently over low heat (or bake at 375°F for 12 minutes) until bubbling and luscious, then shower with fresh sweet basil.
tips: Delivers classic broccoli-rice casserole comfort completely free of canned cream soups or heavy dairy.
Soft, scoopable, and wonderful reheated the next day.

recipes.title: Creamy Cooked Brown Rice, Wild Blueberry & Cinnamon Banana Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lush purple breakfast smoothie spinning soft cooked brown rice with wild blueberries, frozen ripe banana, cinnamon, cold-pressed flaxseed oil, and unsweetened almond milk.
steps: Combine unsweetened almond milk and soft cooked brown rice in the blender and whirl on high for 25 seconds until creamy like rice milk.
Add frozen wild blueberries, frozen banana, cinnamon, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend 45 seconds more until velvet-smooth and pour immediately.
tips: Blending cooked brown rice straight into liquid gives natural whole-grain body and gentle steady energy with zero chalkiness.
Great way to repurpose leftover dinner brown rice into an effortless morning drink.

recipes.title: Velvety Dark Chocolate, Sweet Cherry & Cooked Brown Rice Shake
recipes.summary: Rich malt-style smoothie pairing soft cooked brown rice, pitted sweet cherries, finely grated dark chocolate, ripe banana, Medjool date, cinnamon, and oat milk.
steps: Blend oat milk, soft cooked brown rice, and pitted Medjool date on high for 30 seconds until smooth and frothy.
Add frozen sweet cherries, banana, finely grated dark chocolate, and cinnamon.
Blend 45 to 60 seconds until lush, thick, and malt-smooth.
tips: Cooked brown rice lends a subtly toasted cereal note that tastes reminiscent of a classic chocolate malt shake.
Run the blender a full minute so every grain turns completely silky.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric, Ripe Apricot, Ginger & Creamy Brown Rice Lassi
recipes.summary: Sunny dairy-free lassi spinning soft cooked brown rice, coconut water, ripe apricots, peeled orange, frozen banana, warming turmeric, fresh ginger, and black pepper.

ingredient_details.item: pitted fresh or soft dried apricots

steps: Blend chilled coconut water and cooked brown rice on high for 25 seconds until milky and smooth.
Add pitted apricots, peeled orange, frozen banana, turmeric, grated ginger, and a tiny pinch of cracked black pepper.
Whirl 45 seconds until radiant gold and cloud-creamy.
tips: Coconut water hydrates lightly while cooked brown rice turns the drink satisfyingly creamy.
Add a splash more water if you prefer a lighter afternoon refresher.

recipes.title: Iced Cold-Brew Coffee, Cinnamon & Cooked Brown Rice Horchata Smoothie
recipes.summary: Frothy café horchata shake uniting cooked brown rice, chilled cold-brew coffee, Medjool date, finely grated dark chocolate, frozen banana, cinnamon, and almond milk.
steps: Blend cold-brew coffee, almond milk, cooked brown rice, and pitted date on high for 30 seconds until smooth.
Add frozen banana, grated dark chocolate, cinnamon, and 3 ice cubes.
Blend until frothy and horchata-velvety, then serve immediately.
tips: Gives beloved cinnamon rice horchata flavor with a gentle chilled coffee lift.
Make ahead by freezing leftover cooked brown rice in 1/3-cup silicone tray portions.

recipes.title: Calming Chamomile, Sweet Raspberry & Brown Rice Cream Blush Smoothie
recipes.summary: Soothing pink blend uniting chilled brewed chamomile tea, cooked brown rice, frozen raspberries, banana, Medjool date, sweet almond oil, and oat milk.
steps: Blend chilled chamomile tea, oat milk, cooked brown rice, and pitted date on high for 30 seconds until creamy.
Add frozen raspberries, banana, and sweet almond oil; blend 45 seconds until lush rosy pink.
Pass through a fine sieve if you prefer zero raspberry seeds, or pour right into a chilled glass.
tips: Naturally caffeine-free and soothingly gentle on digestion for quiet afternoons.
Brown rice thickens herbal tea smoothies gracefully without heavy nut butters.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Orange, Ginger, Clove & Cooked Brown Rice Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright spiced creamsicle spinning soft cooked brown rice with steamed sweet carrot, peeled orange, frozen banana, ginger, cinnamon, and a warm pinch of clove.
steps: Blend cold water and cooked brown rice on high for 30 seconds until smooth and milky.
Add steamed carrot coins, peeled orange, frozen banana, grated ginger, cinnamon, and ground clove.
Whirl 45 to 60 seconds until sunlit orange and completely silky.
tips: Nut-free and dairy-free while staying wonderfully thick thanks to cooked brown rice.
Steaming carrots ahead guarantees velvet texture even in everyday blenders.

recipes.title: Deep Blackberry, Blueberry, Sweet Basil & Brown Rice Almond Shake
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich violet smoothie spinning cooked brown rice, blanched almonds, frozen blackberries, blueberries, sweet basil leaves, banana, and roasted walnut oil.
steps: Blend cold water, cooked brown rice, and sliced almonds on high for 30 seconds until creamy white.
Add frozen blackberries, blueberries, sweet basil leaves, ripe banana, and roasted walnut oil.
Blend 60 seconds until deep violet and velvety smooth.
tips: Sweet basil lifts dark summer berries with bright garden freshness.
Blending for a full minute ensures berries and rice spin totally smooth.

recipes.title: Frothy Cantaloupe, Cucumber, Spearmint & Cooked Brown Rice Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cooling peach-gold shake blending chilled cantaloupe, peeled cucumber, fresh spearmint, ginger, frozen banana, coconut water, and silky cooked brown rice.
steps: Blend chilled coconut water and cooked brown rice on high for 25 seconds until light and creamy.
Add cantaloupe cubes, peeled cucumber, fresh spearmint, grated ginger, and frozen banana.
Blend 45 seconds until airy, frosty, and soothingly smooth.
tips: Hydrating melon and cucumber meet gentle whole-grain creaminess for warm afternoons.
Completely nut-free and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Ruby Beetroot, Cranberry, Sweet Apple & Brown Rice Velvet Smoothie
recipes.summary: Jewel-crimson smoothie balancing cooked beetroot and tart cranberries with sweet apple, fresh orange juice, ginger, cinnamon, and creamy cooked brown rice.
steps: Blend cold water and soft cooked brown rice on high for 30 seconds until milky.
Add orange juice, cooked beetroot, frozen cranberries, chopped sweet apple, grated ginger, and cinnamon.
Blend 60 seconds until brilliant magenta and completely silky.
tips: Soft cooked brown rice gently rounds out tart cranberries and earthy beets without needing dairy yogurt.
Peeling the apple keeps every sip velvet-smooth.

recipes.title: Cozy Butternut Squash, Chilled Black Tea Chai & Brown Rice Smoothie
recipes.summary: Spiced autumn chai smoothie spinning chilled strong black tea with cooked brown rice, velvety butternut squash, banana, Medjool date, cinnamon, ginger, and clove.
steps: Blend chilled brewed black tea, cooked brown rice, and pitted date on high for 30 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Add chilled cooked butternut squash, frozen banana, cinnamon, ginger, ground clove, and 3 ice cubes.
Blend 45 seconds until thick, fragrant, and chai-velvety.
tips: Combines comforting rice pudding warmth with chilled masala chai refreshment.
Use decaf black tea if enjoying late in the day.

recipes.title: Chilled Toasted Brown Rice, Cinnamon, Anise & Medjool Date Horchata
recipes.summary: Authentic aromatic horchata made from lightly toasted brown rice, almonds, cinnamon, anise seed, bright orange zest, and sweet Medjool dates blended and strained over ice.

ingredient_details.item: cooked or soaked lightly toasted brown rice

equipment: Nut milk bag or fine strainer
steps: Lightly toast cooked or rinsed dry brown rice in a dry skillet for 3 minutes until nutty-fragrant (if starting dry, soak 30 minutes in hot water first and drain).
Blend brown rice, drained almonds, cold water, pitted dates, cinnamon, anise seeds, and orange zest on high for 60 seconds.
Strain smoothly through a fine mesh strainer or nut milk bag into a chilled pitcher and serve over ice.
tips: Using already-cooked brown rice skips overnight soaking and makes silky horchata in 10 minutes flat.
Give the pitcher a gentle stir before pouring as natural rice starch and cinnamon settle softly.

recipes.title: Iced Korean Toasted Brown Rice Tea (Hyeonmi-Cha) with Apple & Ginger
recipes.summary: Crisp nutty Korean toasted brown rice infusion (hyeonmi-cha) steeped with fresh ginger and cinnamon, chilled and brightened with crisp apple juice, lemon, and spearmint.

ingredient_details.note: rinsed, drained, and dry-toasted until golden

steps: Toast rinsed, drained brown rice in a dry saucepan over medium heat 4 to 5 minutes, stirring gently, until deeply golden and smelling like warm popcorn.
Add filtered water, sliced ginger, and cinnamon stick; simmer gently 5 minutes, then strain cleanly into a pitcher and chill.
Stir in crisp apple juice, lemon juice, and lightly bruised spearmint leaves and serve frosty over ice.
tips: Hyeonmi-cha (toasted brown rice tea) is naturally 100% caffeine-free, hydrating, and soothing for all hours of the day.
Toast a 2-cup jar of dry brown rice once a month so steeping a pitcher takes only 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Saffron, Apricot & Ginger Chilled Toasted Brown Rice Milk
recipes.summary: Silky golden strained brown rice milk infused with steeped saffron threads, soft sweet apricots, fresh ginger, cinnamon, and Medjool date.
steps: Steep saffron threads in 2 tablespoons warm water for 5 minutes until brilliant gold.
Blend cooked brown rice, drained soft apricots, pitted date, grated ginger, cinnamon, saffron water, and cold filtered water on high for 60 seconds.
Strain smoothly through fine mesh into chilled glasses and serve cold over ice.
tips: Completely nut-free and dairy-free with luscious golden color and gentle natural fruit sweetness.
Also comforting gently warmed in a mug on cool evenings.

recipes.title: Chilled Roasted Brown Rice & Spiced Clove-Ginger Black Tea Cooler
recipes.summary: Genmaicha-inspired iced black tea steeping golden toasted brown rice alongside black tea, fresh ginger, cinnamon, and whole cloves mellowed with subtle Medjool date.
steps: Simmer toasted golden brown rice, sliced ginger, cinnamon, and whole cloves in water for 5 minutes until nutty and aromatic.
Remove from heat, add black tea bags, and steep 3 minutes; strain cleanly into a pitcher.
Stir in date syrup, chill well, and pour over tall glasses of ice.
tips: Toasted brown rice softens black tea tannins with warm caramel-popcorn depth—zero dairy needed.
Add a splash of oat milk if you enjoy a creamy iced tea latte.

recipes.title: Tranquil Chamomile, Culinary Lavender & Apple Chilled Brown Rice Milk
recipes.summary: Calming floral evening cooler swirling strained homemade brown rice milk with chilled chamomile-lavender infusion, crisp apple juice, cinnamon, and Medjool date.
steps: Steep chamomile and culinary lavender in 1.25 cups hot water for 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend cooked brown rice, cold water, pitted date, and cinnamon on high for 60 seconds, then strain silky smooth.
Stir chilled chamomile-lavender tea, cloudy apple juice, and fresh brown rice milk together and serve cool.
tips: Completely caffeine-free, nut-free, and dairy-free for gentle late-evening hydration.
Strain well so every sip glides smoothly.

recipes.title: Chilled Cold-Brew Coffee, Dark Chocolate & Cinnamon Brown Rice Horchata
recipes.summary: Mexican café horchata marrying smooth cold-brew coffee with freshly strained dark chocolate-cinnamon brown rice milk, Medjool date sweetness, and a hint of cayenne.
steps: Blend cooked brown rice, cold water, pitted dates, grated dark chocolate, cinnamon, and a whisper of cayenne on high for 60 seconds.
Strain smoothly through fine mesh into a chilled pitcher.
Pour chilled cold-brew coffee over ice and top with swirling chocolate-cinnamon brown rice horchata.
tips: Nut-free coffee-shop luxury crafted from pantry staples in 6 minutes.
Leave out the pinch of cayenne if you prefer gentle mild chocolate-cinnamon flavor.

recipes.title: Bright Orange, Pressed Carrot & Golden Turmeric Brown Rice Milk Cooler
recipes.summary: Sunny citrus-carrot cooler swirling strained silky homemade brown rice milk with fresh orange juice, carrot juice, warming turmeric, grated ginger, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Blend soft cooked brown rice with cold water on high for 60 seconds, then strain smoothly into a pitcher.
Whisk in fresh orange juice, carrot juice, turmeric, grated ginger, and a tiny pinch of cracked black pepper.
Serve well chilled over ice.
tips: Freshly strained brown rice milk turns crisp citrus-carrot juice into a light nut-free creamsicle.
Stir before pouring since rice milk naturally separates gently when chilled.

recipes.title: Cooling Cantaloupe, Cucumber & Lemon Balm Brown Rice Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Refreshing summer melon agua fresca straining ripe cantaloupe, peeled cucumber, fresh lemon balm, ginger, date, and velvety cooked brown rice milk.
steps: Blend cooked brown rice, cold water, and pitted date on high for 45 seconds until milky.
Add ripe cantaloupe, peeled cucumber, lemon balm leaves, and grated ginger; blend 30 seconds more.
Strain smoothly through fine mesh into chilled glasses over ice and sip fresh.
tips: Lightly creamy, deeply hydrating, and 100% nut-free and dairy-free.
Lemon balm lends delicate citrus-mint garden fragrance.

recipes.title: Festive Cranberry, Orange & Rosemary Chilled Brown Rice Milk Spritz
recipes.summary: Sparkling jewel-ruby cooler layering muddled rosemary, tart cranberry, sweet apple, and orange juice with lightly strained cinnamon brown rice milk and sparkling water.
steps: Blend cooked brown rice with 3/4 cup cold water and cinnamon for 60 seconds, then strain cleanly into a small pitcher.
Gently muddle rosemary in a mixing glass, stir in cranberry, orange, and apple juices, and strain out rosemary.
Pour ruby fruit juice over ice, swirl with chilled cinnamon brown rice milk, and float sparkling water gently on top.
tips: A bright, festive alcohol-free spritz that works wonderfully for guests with nut or dairy sensitivities.
Serve immediately while lightly effervescent.

recipes.title: Iced Roasted Brown Rice Infusion with Red Grape, Celery & Fresh Shiso
recipes.summary: Botanical Japanese-Korean fusion tonic pairing chilled toasted brown rice tea (hyeonmi-cha) with strained red grape, celery stalk, crisp apple, fresh shiso, and ginger.
steps: Simmer toasted golden brown rice in 1.5 cups water for 6 minutes until fragrant and amber, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend red grapes, chopped celery, apple, shiso leaves, grated ginger, and remaining 1/2 cup cold water for 45 seconds, then strain firmly through fine mesh.
Stir the ruby botanical juice together with the chilled toasted brown rice infusion and serve over ice.
tips: Nutty caffeine-free roasted brown rice tea balances crisp celery and floral shiso gracefully.
No juicer needed—a simple blender and mesh strainer do all the work.
